headline: Tk 30 million looted from bKash car in Sreepur; manager shot
summary: Armed robbers blocked a private car carrying cash for a bKash distribution company, shooting the accounts manager and stealing two bags of money.
details: A group of 10 to 12 people on motorcycles blocked a private car belonging to a bKash distribution company in the Karnapur area of Sreepur, Gazipur, on Friday evening.
The attackers used Chinese axes and local weapons to break the car's glass, and one assailant shot the accounts manager, Himel, before fleeing with approximately Tk 30 million.
Three people were injured in the attack, including Himel, driver Lal Mia, and area manager Farhad. Himel was transported to Gazipur Shaheed Tajuddin Ahmad Medical College Hospital for treatment.
The cash was being transported to a distributor in Narsingdi Sadar to address a cash shortage caused by bank closures on Friday and garment worker wage payments.
Sreepur Police Station chief Mohammad Shahinur Alam confirmed that law enforcement agencies have launched an investigation and are collecting evidence from the scene and the victims.
caption:
Tk 30 million stolen in a daring daylight robbery! A bKash manager was shot as armed men on motorcycles blocked a car in Gazipur.

A group of 10 to 12 people on motorcycles blocked a private car belonging to a bKash distribution company in the Karnapur area of Sreepur, Gazipur, on Friday evening.

The attackers used Chinese axes and local weapons to break the car's glass, and one assailant shot the accounts manager, Himel, before fleeing with approximately Tk 30 million.

Three people were injured in the attack, including Himel, driver Lal Mia, and area manager Farhad. Himel was transported to Gazipur Shaheed Tajuddin Ahmad Medical College Hospital for treatment.

The cash was being transported to a distributor in Narsingdi Sadar to address a cash shortage caused by bank closures on Friday and garment worker wage payments.

Sreepur Police Station chief Mohammad Shahinur Alam confirmed that law enforcement agencies have launched an investigation and are collecting evidence from the scene and the victims.

headline_marked: 250-run chase: [[West Indies beat India]] in record-breaking T20I
headline: 250-run chase: West Indies beat India in record-breaking T20I
summary: Shai Hope's unbeaten century and Sherfane Rutherford's 84 power the Windies to their highest successful chase in T20 internationals.
details: West Indies achieved their highest successful run chase in T20 internationals, overhauling a target of 250 to beat India by six wickets in Ranchi.
Shai Hope anchored the victory with an unbeaten 102 off 45 balls, while Sherfane Rutherford smashed 84 off 37 balls to turn the match on its head.
The duo shared a blistering 120-run partnership for the fourth wicket after West Indies were rocked early by Mayank Yadav's successive wickets.
Earlier, India posted a massive total of 249-5, driven by Sanju Samson's 82 off 41 balls and a late surge by Iyer and Tilak Varma.
The win levels the five-match series at 1-1, marking the second-highest successful run chase in men's T20 international history.
West Indies completed the chase with nine balls to spare, securing a dramatic victory over the hosts.
caption:
A record-breaking chase! West Indies hunt down 250 to stun India.

West Indies achieved their highest successful run chase in T20 internationals, overhauling a target of 250 to beat India by six wickets in Ranchi.

Shai Hope anchored the victory with an unbeaten 102 off 45 balls, while Sherfane Rutherford smashed 84 off 37 balls to turn the match on its head.

The duo shared a blistering 120-run partnership for the fourth wicket after West Indies were rocked early by Mayank Yadav's successive wickets.

Earlier, India posted a massive total of 249-5, driven by Sanju Samson's 82 off 41 balls and a late surge by Iyer and Tilak Varma.

The win levels the five-match series at 1-1, marking the second-highest successful run chase in men's T20 international history.

West Indies completed the chase with nine balls to spare, securing a dramatic victory over the hosts.
